name: content batching
pitch: A checklist to plan and run filming days so edits are ready later
instructions:
# content batching checklist

## how to run it
1. **list the videos** – open a blank document and write every video you want to film. include title, topic, length and any props needed.
2. **gather assets** – check you have all gear, memory cards, batteries and a quiet spot. note any items you need to buy or borrow.
3. **set the time** – pick a date and time that works for you. write it at the top of the list.
4. **film** – record each video in order. speak clearly and keep each take under two minutes.
5. **note next steps** – after each clip, write a short note: the clip name, any B‑roll you still need and the upload platform.
6. **save and label** – when the session ends, save the file with the date and “batch” in the name. put it in a folder called “filming batches”.

## what to do when stuck
- if you cannot find a piece of gear, say “i could not locate [item]. let me know if you want to buy or borrow it.”
- if you lose the list, say “i cannot find the checklist. would you like me to recreate it?”

## what the agent shows you
at the end, the agent presents the completed checklist as a simple text page. it also offers to save the file to your workspace or to create a new list if you start a fresh batch.

examples.ask: i need a checklist for a filming day
examples.does: the agent opens a blank document and lists the steps above, then asks if you want to save it

examples.ask: can you make a checklist for three videos?
examples.does: the agent adds three video entries to the checklist and saves the file as "filming batch – 2026-01-15"

skills.name: make-checklist
skills.body: 1. open a new blank document with make_page. 2. write the heading "filming day checklist". 3. add the six steps from the instructions, each on its own line. 4. save the file with file_write using the name "filming checklist – [today's date]". 5. show the person the finished page and ask if they want to add any extra steps.

readme:
# content batching

a checklist to plan and run filming days so edits are ready later.

what it does: lists videos, gathers gear, sets a time, records clips and notes next steps.
what it needs: file_write and make_page tools.
what it will not do: it cannot film the videos for you or choose the upload times.
